Xroga compatibility modification, 2026-10-15

Upstream: Cline / @cline/core 0.0.82, https://github.com/cline/cline
Copyright 2026 Cline Bot Inc. Apache License 2.0; included in LICENSE.
License source pinned at repository commit 83ea9a41d11d733015adc63f47f7363098db2231.

Xroga changes exactly one import in each of three hash-pinned compiled bundles:
default simple-git factory import -> named simpleGit factory import.
This admits simple-git 4.0.2 while preserving the installed Cline 0.0.82 runtime.
All other runtime bytes, copyrights and upstream notices are retained.
The changed files each carry a modification notice. No upstream endorsement is implied.
The reproducible transform and original/installed hashes are in backend/scripts/cline-git-compat.mjs.
